answer: Locks are recorded in dawn, expire in thread, and jetty lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 101 aliases therefore needs 189 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1052 identities would post 1700 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
